meta_description: Mercedes BR Jaya Half Marathon Duathlon 2026 review: November 15 at AEON Mall Kulai Jaya, Johor -- a dual running-plus-duathlon event format.
dek: Set for 15 November 2026 at AEON Mall Kulai Jaya, this JomRun-organised event combines a standard half marathon with a duathlon format, in a landlocked Johor district roughly the size of Singapore.
verdict: The Mercedes BR Jaya event stands out for combining two race formats under one event: a standard half marathon (21.1K/10K/5K) alongside a duathlon option -- a genuine rarity among the races in this research batch, most of which are pure running events. It's held at AEON Mall Kulai Jaya, in a district covering roughly 754 square kilometres (nearly the size of Singapore), one of Johor's three landlocked districts. Registration is open with a deadline the day before race day -- a tight window echoing the JomRun organisational pattern seen at the KL Half Marathon and Tebrau City Half Marathon elsewhere in this research.

sections.heading: Two Formats, One Event
paragraphs: The event combines a standard half marathon -- 21.1K, 10K and 5K distances -- with a duathlon option, at AEON Mall Kulai Jaya, Johor. [1] That dual-format structure is genuinely uncommon among the races covered in this research batch, which are almost entirely pure running events -- the duathlon component adds a run-bike-run (or similar) variant for participants wanting a different physical challenge.

sections.heading: Kulai: A Landlocked District Nearly the Size of Singapore
paragraphs: Kulai is the district capital of Kulai District, Johor, established in 1890 and one of only three landlocked districts in Johor. [2] The district covers 753.75 square kilometres -- slightly smaller than Singapore -- and sits within the Iskandar Malaysia economic zone, giving the area genuine economic development momentum alongside its historical Hakka-Chinese settlement roots.

sections.heading: A Familiar JomRun Structure
paragraphs: As with the KL Half Marathon and Tebrau City Half Marathon covered elsewhere in this research batch, this event is organised via JomRun, giving it a tested registration and race-day framework even for a less internationally known Johor town. [1] Registration is open but closes 14 November 2026 -- the day before race day, matching the tight-window pattern seen at other JomRun events.

sections.heading: A Mall-Anchored Venue
paragraphs: AEON Mall Kulai Jaya provides built-in parking, shelter and amenities for both the running and duathlon components -- consistent with the mall-anchored venue pattern used across several other races in this research batch.

sections.heading: Should You Run It?
paragraphs: If you want the option to try a duathlon alongside a standard half marathon at a single event, Mercedes BR Jaya on 15 November 2026 is a genuinely distinctive pick in Johor. Register before the 14 November deadline, given JomRun's consistently tight registration windows.
